class.name: TdJsonClient
class.description: Sends requests to an individual TDLib client and emits responses received by [code]TdJsonManager[/code].

method.name: get_client_id
method.description: Returns the client ID of the session.

method.name: send
method.description: Sends a request to the TDLib client. May be called from any thread.

method.name: set_bot_token
method.description: Sets the authentication token of a bot and logs in when TDLib reaches [code]authorizationStateWaitPhoneNumber[/code].

signal.name: response_received
signal.description: Emits when a response or update is received for this client.
